clock: max_of_synchronized_host_wall_and_cuda_event per score call; only the pass on the row's own tensors is timed, after an untimed pass on random tensors of the same shapes and before an untimed determinism pass on fresh copies
fresh_process: per shard: Phase A and Phase B are separate processes on the same GPU
overhead_reference: trusted plain prefill of the same row re-measured in Phase B on the same device
warmup: untimed fully gated passes over all layers on 2048- and 128-token random decoys
